prompts.note: edit, passing test, git merge with a diff: the merge does not invalidate the check
stash + rebase + stash pop only mutate through git operations
only a git merge: no edits of the agent
check.sh && git mv in one command: the edit before it was checked; the move is a git op
a real edit after the merge makes the prompt unchecked (1 edit after last check)
failing check, then git checkout/cherry-pick: status stays failing
git mv without a diff in the log is a git-op edit: status unchanged
